The colours BlackThriveSS charts use

Source: R/theme.R
btg_colours.Rd

A named vector of the dashboard's chart colours, so that figures drawn outside the package can match them.

Usage

btg_colours()

Value

A named character vector of hex colours: bar for the main series, bar_partial for forces with incomplete or unverified returns, ink, secondary and muted for text, grid and baseline for chart chrome, and surface for the chart background.

Examples

btg_colours()[c("bar", "bar_partial")]
#>         bar bar_partial 
#>   "#E69F00"   "#F5D27A"
